name: abdm-portal
description: The ABDM Developer Portal: integration skills for ABDM and NHCX integrators, and the contributor's assistant for building the portal itself

plugins.name: abdm-integrators-assistant
plugins.description: Build and debug an ABDM integration. Build skills scaffold a milestone flow by flow against the sandbox, M1 to M4 on the provider side and P1 to P3 inside a PHR application. Debug skills walk a failed call to a named fix, citing the Catalogue atom behind every step. fhir-generate and fhir-audit build or audit NRCES compliant FHIR document bundles against the Docs MCP validator.

plugins.name: nhcx
plugins.description: Build an NHCX claims integration into a hospital information system or a standalone claims desk. One skill per use case, in episode order: coverage, insurance plan, pre-authorisation, claim, payment, communication and reprocess. Each checks what the system already has, builds only what is missing, and is held to the NHCX package's pinned FHIR bundles.

plugins.name: abdm-contributors-assistant
plugins.description: Build and operate the ABDM Developer Portal: atom authoring, verification, linting, OpenAPI ingestion, Scalar docs, skill compilation, the update pipeline, the support agent, planning and proof. Compiled from the architecture and execution plan in this repo.
